prompt: Build a context manifest for a local UI fix. The project has many installed skills and several declared source-of-truth files, but only project-context and ui-improvement are relevant. Do not bulk-load unrelated skills or declared documents.
expected_outcomes: Only explicitly selected skills enter active context
Declared source-of-truth remains discoverable without automatic bulk loading
Context telemetry reports characters and estimated tokens
must_not: Treat every installed skill as active context
Load all declared source documents just because they exist
Invent a universal context-window utilization threshold
